observation_definitions.any_tool_error: at least one actual tool error; may overlap all other stages
observation_definitions.financial_qualified: complete trajectory financial qualification from the separately sealed R1 score
observation_definitions.nonempty_discovery_return: any nonempty query_source/list_concepts/read_json return; not financial correctness
observation_definitions.nonempty_query_observed: a successful query_source returned at least one original record
observation_definitions.numeric_source_read_observed: successful numeric read_source or original /val observed through read_json
observation_definitions.repeat_query_without_new_public_evidence: same canonical query and unchanged public evidence state
observation_definitions.runtime_recognized_final: runtime recorded the first parsed top-level final, regardless of financial validity
observation_definitions.successful_calculation_observed: successful numeric calculate; requested quantity not inferred from this flag
